description: This file defines the CommitMessageOrchestrator class responsible for orchestrating commit message generation workflows, including change resolution and integration with Git and IDE components.

classes.name: CommitMessageOrchestrator
classes.description: A class that manages the process of generating commit messages by coordinating Git operations, change resolution, and IDE integration.

methods.name: generateCommitMessage
methods.description: Generates a commit message using a workflow that involves Git change discovery, context gathering, and message generation, with progress reporting and error handling.

methods.name: resolveCommitChanges
methods.description: Resolves which files and changes should be included in the commit message, prioritizing selected files, then staged, then unstaged changes.
